test.create_query: CREATE TABLE partition_value_index (tenant UInt16, ts DateTime('UTC'), value UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree PARTITION BY (tenant, toYYYYMMDD(ts)) ORDER BY ts
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO partition_value_index SELECT intDiv(number, 10), toDateTime('2026-09-01 00:00:00', 'UTC') + (number % 10) * 86400, number FROM numbers(10000)
test.query: SELECT sum(value) FROM partition_value_index WHERE tenant = 500 AND ts >= toDateTime('2026-09-03 00:00:00', 'UTC') AND ts < toDateTime('2026-09-06 00:00:00', 'UTC')
SELECT sum(value) FROM partition_value_index WHERE tenant IN (10, 500, 999)
SELECT sum(value) FROM partition_value_index WHERE toYYYYMMDD(ts) = 20260905
